say:2:1041406001:1.text: Being a knight of the Temple is not easy.
say:2:1041406001:1.source_cn: 圣堂的骑士也是不容易啊。

say:3:1041406002:1.text: Oh, come on, you guys in the Heroic Order seem to have it tougher...
say:3:1041406002:1.source_cn: 哪里，你们骑士团看起来更辛苦……

choice_prompt:4:1041406002.text: Oh, come on, you guys in the Heroic Order seem to have it tougher...
choice_prompt:4:1041406002.source_cn: 哪里，你们骑士团看起来更辛苦……

say:5:1041406003:1.text: Oh, we're just talking about work-related stuff.
say:5:1041406003:1.source_cn: 哦，我们在聊工作的事啦。

say:6:1041406005:1.text: I was just discussing the specifics of the Templar Knights with Lucius. There are some differences I've noticed.
say:6:1041406005:1.source_cn: 我也是正规骑士团的成员，所以正在跟卢修斯聊圣堂骑士那边...

say:7:1041406006:1.text: For example, Lucius' armor is made of a different material than the ones from the Heroic Order.
say:7:1041406006:1.source_cn: 比如，你看，卢修斯的铠甲材料和骑士团的就不一样。

choice_prompt:8:1041406006.text: For example, Lucius' armor is made of a different material than the ones from the Heroic Order.
choice_prompt:8:1041406006.source_cn: 比如，你看，卢修斯的铠甲材料和骑士团的就不一样。

say:9:1041406007:1.text: The Templar Knights' armor is more expensive. If their armor gets damaged, the knights usually have to pay for the repairs themselves.
say:9:1041406007:1.source_cn: 圣堂骑士的铠甲更昂贵，如果出现破损，很多需要自费修理。

say:10:1041406008:1.text: I heard that in the Heroic Order, because of frequent combat and lower costs, they apparently get a new set for free if theirs gets damaged...
say:10:1041406008:1.source_cn: 我听同僚们说，骑士团那边因为实战多，而且造价低，据说是...

say:11:1041406009:1.text: That's not true! Even the General has to pay for his damaged armor. He just reshapes the original armor pieces himself.
say:11:1041406009:1.source_cn: ……哪有这种好事！将军的铠甲坏掉也是自己买单，把原本的...

say:12:1041406010:1.text: And maintaining the armor is a chore. Even if I don't wear it, I have to specially care for it every month.
say:12:1041406010:1.source_cn: 而且铠甲要维护，我自己的铠甲就算不穿，每个月也要专门保养。

say:13:1041406011:1.text: But I heard that the Templar Knights have squires dedicated to maintaining armor...
say:13:1041406011:1.source_cn: 我听说，你们圣堂骑士那里会有专门的侍从去保养铠甲？

say:14:1041406012:1.text: You're probably confusing us with the nobles and their personal servants. Templar Knights don't have any attendants, so we painstakingly do everything ourselves.
say:14:1041406012:1.source_cn: 你大概是把贵族们自带的仆人搞混了，圣堂骑士可没有你们那...

choice_prompt:15:1041406012.text: You're probably confusing us with the nobles and their personal servants. Templar Knights don't have any attendants, so we painstakingly do everything ourselves.
choice_prompt:15:1041406012.source_cn: 你大概是把贵族们自带的仆人搞混了，圣堂骑士可没有你们那种骑士侍从……所有的事都要亲力亲为。

say:16:1041406013:1.text: Well, we all gotta do what we must to survive.
say:16:1041406013:1.source_cn: 毕竟这个世道，工作和生活才是要面对的现实啊。

say:17:1041406015:1.text: Templar Knight or member of the Heroic Order... Maybe the ideals and jobs differ, but the pressures to face are the same...
say:17:1041406015:1.source_cn: 骑士也好圣骑士也罢，或许理念和工作有所不同，但要面临的...

say:19:1041406014:1.text: Ha! I know, right? I thought becoming a knight would be a more romantic experience, but I'm not as idealistic as I was when I was a kid.
say:19:1041406014:1.source_cn: 谁让我们生活在现实世界而不是浪漫文学里呢，只能面对现实了。

say:20:1041406004:1.text: ... You're funny, Magister. I can never tell if you're teasing me or not.
say:20:1041406004:1.source_cn: 这话真失礼啊，我可是跟谁都能聊两句的。
